notes: One entry per {{Enemy Infobox}} (variants such as 'Jaw Worm (Hard)' are separate entries and share the base moveset). hp.base/hp.ascension are [min, max]; StS1 'ascension' HP applies from A7 (normal) / A8 (elite) / A9 (boss), StS2 from A8. Move effects keep ascension values inline as '(A2: 12)'; damage/hits are the base (A0) numbers parsed from the effect (null for non-attacks or variable damage). intent = schema label from the wiki intent icons (intent_icons keeps the raw codes). pattern = the wiki's prose under the intents table (AI rules, weights, phase changes), plain text, capped at 3000 chars; [Heading] marks a sub-section such as a phase. passives = infobox powers, with the power definition when the page has one. encounters = '<act> <pool>: <encounter>' labels from the encounter lists (pools: easy, hard, elite, boss, event). Completeness: enemy counts per category equal the wiki's Cargo 'Enemies' table (66 vs 66); differences against the enemy data module are explained in 'completeness'.

enemies.name: Acid Slime (L)

moves.name: Corrosive Spit
moves.effect: Deals 11 (A2: 12) damage. Adds 2 Slimed into your discard pile.

moves.name: Split
moves.effect: Disappears and spawns 2 Acid Slimes (M) with its current HP.

enemies.pattern: Has a 30% (A17: 40%) chance of using Corrosive Spit, a 40% (A17: 30%) chance of using Tackle and a 30% chance of using Lick every turn. Cannot use Tackle (A17: Lick) twice in a row and cannot use other moves three times in a row. Once its HP reaches 50% or lower, its current Intent will be interrupted and changed to Split.
passives: Split — When its HP is at or below 50%, it will split into 2 smaller Slimes with its current HP.

enemies.name: Acid Slime (M)

moves.name: Corrosive Spit
moves.effect: Deals 7 (A2: 8) damage. Adds a Slimed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Identical pattern to Acid Slime (L) but it cannot Split. On Ascension 17: Every turn it has a 40% change of using Corrosive Spit, a 40% chance of using Tackle, and a 20% chance of using Lick. Lick cannot be used twice in a row and other moves cannot be used 3 times in a row.

enemies.name: Blue Slaver
enemies.pattern: Each turn, Blue Slaver has a 60% chance to use Stab and a 40% chance to use Rake. The same attack cannot be used three times in a row. On Ascension 17, Blue Slaver will never use Rake twice in a row.

enemies.name: Cultist
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Incantation, then uses Dark Strike every turn after.

enemies.name: Fat Gremlin

moves.name: Smash
moves.effect: Deals 4 (A2: 5) damage. Applies 1 Weak. (A17: and 1 Frail.)

enemies.pattern: Fat Gremlin uses Smash every turn.

enemies.name: Fungi Beast
enemies.pattern: Fungi Beast will use one of the following attacks each turn: * Bite (60% chance) * Grow (40% chance) Fungi Beast will not use Bite 3 times in a row or Grow twice in a row.
passives: Spore Cloud 2 — On death, applies X Vulnerable.
encounters: Act 2 hard: Shelled Parasite and Fungi

enemies.name: Green Louse

moves.name: Bite
moves.effect: Deals N damage. N = Number between 5-7 (A2: 6-8), chosen at the start of combat.

enemies.pattern: Has a 25% chance to use Spit Web and a 75% chance of using Bite. It cannot use the same move three times in a row. On Ascension 17 it cannot use Spit Web any more than twice in a row.
passives: Curl Up N, where N is random between 3-7 (A7: 4-8 A17: 9-12) — Gains X Block upon first receiving attack damage.

enemies.name: Gremlin Wizard
enemies.pattern: Gremlin Wizard will always start by using Charging twice in a row, then using Ultimate Blast. After that and for the rest of combat, Gremlin Wizard will use Charging three times in a row before using Ultimate Blast. On Ascension 17, Gremlin Wizard will use Charging twice in a row, then use Ultimate Blast every turn for the rest of combat.

enemies.name: Jaw Worm
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Chomp. If it is found in Act 3, it starts with the effects of Bellow, and for its first action it has a 45% chance of starting with Bellow, a 30% chance of Thrash and a 25% chance of using Chomp * After using Chomp, it has a 59% chance of using Bellow and a 41% of Thrash * After using Bellow, it has a 56% chance of using Thrash and a 44% of using Chomp * After using Thrash, it has a 45% chance of using Bellow, a 30% chance of using Thrash and a 25% chance of using Chomp. Unless Thrash has been used 2 turns in a row, then it has a 64% chance of using Bellow, and a 36% of using Chomp

enemies.name: Looter
enemies.pattern: * Uses Mug for the first 2 turns. * Has a 50% chance to use Lunge or 50% chance to use Smoke Bomb. ** If Lunge is used on its third turn, it will then use Smoke Bomb next. * The turn after Smoke Bomb has been used, it will Escape.
passives: Thievery 15 (A17: 20) — Steals X Gold whenever it attacks. Stolen gold is returned if this enemy is killed.

enemies.name: Mad Gremlin
enemies.pattern: Mad Gremlin uses Scratch every turn.
passives: Angry 1 (A17: 2) — Upon receiving attack damage, gains X Strength.

enemies.name: Red Louse

moves.name: Bite
moves.effect: Deals N damage. N = Number between 5-7 (A2: 6-8), chosen at the start of combat.

enemies.pattern: Has a 25% chance to use Grow and a 75% chance of using Bite. It cannot use the same move three times in a row. On Ascension 17 it cannot use Grow any more than twice in a row.
passives: Curl Up N, where N is random between 3-7 (A7: 4-8 A17: 9-12) — Gains X Block upon first receiving attack damage.

enemies.name: Red Slaver
enemies.pattern: Red Slaver will always start the battle with Stab. If Red Slaver has not used Entangle yet, it has a 25% chance to be used each turn. Red Slaver will repeat the pattern of Scrape, Scrape, Stab until Entangle is used. After using Entangle, Red Slaver has a 55% chance of using Stab and a 45% chance of using Scrape. Red Slaver cannot use the same attack three times in a row, and can only use Entangle once per combat. On Ascension 17, Red Slaver will repeat the pattern of Scrape, Stab until Entangle is used. After Entangle is used, Red Slaver cannot use Scrape twice in a row.

enemies.name: Shield Gremlin

moves.name: Protect
moves.effect: Random enemy gains 7 (A2: 8; A17: 11) Block. Only chooses self if alone.

enemies.pattern: Shield Gremlin uses Protect every turn. If it is the only enemy left, it will switch to using Shield Bash every turn.

enemies.name: Sneaky Gremlin
enemies.pattern: Sneaky Gremlin uses Puncture every turn.

enemies.name: Spike Slime (L)

moves.name: Flame Tackle
moves.effect: Deals 16 (A2: 18) damage. Adds 2 Slimed into your discard pile.

moves.name: Split
moves.effect: Disappears and spawns 2 Spike Slimes (M) with its current HP.

enemies.pattern: Has a 30% chance of using Flame Tackle and a 70% chance of using Lick. Cannot use the same move three times in a row. On Ascension 17, it cannot use Lick twice in a row. Once its HP reaches 50% or lower, its current Intent will be interrupted and changed to Split.
passives: Split — When its HP is at or below 50%, it will split into 2 smaller Slimes with its current HP.

enemies.name: Spike Slime (M)

moves.name: Flame Tackle
moves.effect: Deals 8 (A2: 10) damage. Adds a Slimed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Identical to Spike Slime (L) but it cannot Split.

enemies.name: Spike Slime (S)
enemies.pattern: (single move) Uses Tackle every turn.

enemies.name: Byrd
enemies.pattern: Byrd never starts with Swoop. While it has Flying, Byrd will use one of the following actions each turn: * Peck (50% chance) * Caw (30% chance) * Swoop (20% chance) Byrd cannot use Caw and Swoop twice in a row, or Peck three times in a row. [Pattern While Grounded] If Byrd does not have Flying, it will use the following actions in order before returning to its regular pattern: #Stunned (replaces current Intent when Flying is lost) #Headbutt #Go Airborne
passives: Flying 3 (A17: 4) — Takes 50% less attack damage. Cancelled if dealt attack damage X times in one turn. Resets charges at the start of next turn if not fully removed.

enemies.name: Centurion

moves.name: Protect
moves.effect: Mystic gains 15 (A17: 20) Block. If alone, instead gains 15 (A17: 20) Block.

enemies.pattern: Centurion will use one of the following actions each turn if the Mystic is alive: * Slash (65% chance) * Protect (35% chance) If the Mystic is dead, Centurion will replace Protect with Fury. Centurion will never use any move three times in a row.

enemies.name: Chosen
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Poke followed by Hex. After that, repeats the following pattern for the rest of the combat: #Debilitate (50% chance) or Drain (50% chance) #Poke (60% chance) or Zap (40% chance) On Ascension 17, Chosen always starts with Hex instead of Poke.

enemies.name: Mugger
enemies.pattern: Mugger has the same pattern as Looter.
passives: Thievery 15 (A17: 20) — Steals X Gold whenever it attacks. Stolen gold is returned if this enemy is killed.

enemies.name: Mystic
enemies.pattern: If an enemy is missing 16 (A19: 21) or more HP, Mystic will use Heal, up to twice in a row. Otherwise, Mystic will use one of the following actions each turn: * Attack (60% chance) * Buff (40% chance) Mystic will never use Attack or Buff three times in a row. On Ascension 17, Mystic will never use Attack twice in a row.

enemies.name: Shelled Parasite

moves.name: Life Suck
moves.effect: Deals 10 (A2: 12) damage. Heals HP equal to unblocked damage dealt.

enemies.pattern: Shelled Parasite cannot use Fell on its first turn, except on Ascension 17 when it will always start with Fell. After that, it will use one of the following attacks each turn: * Double Strike (40% chance) * Life Suck (40% chance) * Fell (20% chance) Shelled Parasite cannot use Double Strike or Life Suck three times in a row, or Fell twice in a row. If all of its Plated Armor is broken, Shelled Parasite will change its current Intent to Stunned. This can only happen once per combat.
encounters: Act 2 hard: Shelled Parasite and Fungi

enemies.name: Snake Plant
enemies.pattern: Every turn: * Chomp Chomp 65% chance * Enfeebling Spores 35% chance Cannot use Chomp Chomp three times in a row and cannot use Enfeebling Spores twice in a row. On Ascension 17, when it uses Enfeebling Spores for the first time, its pattern changes to: * Chomp Chomp * Chomp Chomp * Enfeebling Spores

enemies.name: Snecko

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.effect: Deals 8 (A2: 10) damage. Applies 2 Vulnerable. (A17: and 2 Weak).

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Perplexing Glare, then uses one of the following actions each turn: * Bite (60% chance) * Tail Whip (40% chance) Snecko will not use Bite three times in a row.

enemies.name: Spheric Guardian
enemies.pattern: Spheric Guardian always starts with Activate, then uses Debuff Attack. Afterwards, Spheric Guardian alternates between using Slam and Harden for the rest of the battle.
encounters: Act 2 hard: Sentry and Spheric Guardian

enemies.name: Darkling

moves.name: Nip
moves.effect: Deals N damage. N = Number between 7-11 (A2: 9-13), chosen at the start of combat.

enemies.pattern: On turn one all Darklings have a 50/50 chance of using either Nip or Harden. The middle Darkling continues this pattern but cannot use Chomp. The outer two Darklings on all other turns: * Nip 30% chance * Chomp 40% chance * Harden 30% chance Neither Harden nor Chomp can be used twice in a row. Nip cannot be used three times in a row. After its HP reaches 0, its current intent changes to Regrowing... and cannot be targeted. On the next turn it will use Reincarnate.
passives: Life Link — If other Darklings are still alive, revives in 2 turns.

enemies.name: Exploder
enemies.pattern: Always uses this pattern: * Attack * Attack * Explode
passives: Explosive 3 — Explodes after X turns, dealing some amount of damage.

enemies.name: Jaw Worm (Hard)
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Chomp. If it is found in Act 3, it starts with the effects of Bellow, and for its first action it has a 45% chance of starting with Bellow, a 30% chance of Thrash and a 25% chance of using Chomp * After using Chomp, it has a 59% chance of using Bellow and a 41% of Thrash * After using Bellow, it has a 56% chance of using Thrash and a 44% of using Chomp * After using Thrash, it has a 45% chance of using Bellow, a 30% chance of using Thrash and a 25% chance of using Chomp. Unless Thrash has been used 2 turns in a row, then it has a 64% chance of using Bellow, and a 36% of using Chomp

enemies.name: Orb Walker

moves.name: Laser
moves.effect: Deals 10 (A2: 11) damage. Adds a Burn into your draw pile, and another Burn into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Orb Walker will use one of the following actions each turn: * Laser (60% chance) * Claw (40% chance) Orb Walker cannot use either action three times in a row.
passives: Strength Up 3 (A17: 5) — At the end of its turn, gains Strength.

enemies.name: Repulsor

moves.name: Daze
moves.effect: Adds 2 Dazed into your draw pile.

enemies.pattern: On all turns: * Attack 20% chance * Daze 80% chance Cannot use Attack twice in a row.

enemies.name: Spiker
enemies.pattern: On every turn, it has a 50/50 chance of using either Attack or Buff Thorns. Cannot use Attack twice in a row. Cannot use Buff Thorns once it has been used 6 times and will instead using Attack.

enemies.name: Spire Growth
enemies.pattern: Each turn, it has a 50/50 chance to use either Quick Tackle or Constrict. If Constrict was used last turn or the player already has Constricted, it uses Smash instead. Cannot use either attack three times in a row.

enemies.name: The Maw

moves.name: Nom Nom
moves.effect: Deals 5×N damage. N = Current turn, divided by two (rounded up).

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Roar. Afterwards it has a 50/50 chance of using either Slam or Nom Nom. After using Drool: 50/50 split between Slam and Nom Nom. After using Slam: 50/50 split between Nom Nom and Drool. After using Nom Nom: Always uses Drool.

enemies.name: Transient

moves.name: Attack
moves.effect: Deals 20+N (A2: 30+N) damage. N = Current turn, multiplied by 10.

enemies.pattern: (single move) Uses Attack every turn.
passives: Shifting — Upon losing HP, loses that much Strength until the end of the turn.

enemies.name: Writhing Mass

moves.name: Debuff Attack
moves.effect: Deals 10 (A2: 12) damage. Applies 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable.

moves.name: Parasite
moves.effect: Permanently adds a Parasite to your deck.

enemies.pattern: On its first turn, it has an (approximately) equal chance to use Multi Hit, Big Hit, or Debuff Attack. Afterwards: * Parasite 10% chance * Block Attack 30% chance * Debuff Attack 20% chance * Multi Hit 30% chance * Big Hit 10% chance Parasite can only be used once. The same move cannot be used (or rerolled via Reactive) twice in a row. (table omitted)
passives: Reactive — Upon receiving attack damage, changes its Intent.

enemies.name: Gremlin Nob
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Bellow then has a 33% chance of using Skull Bash and a 67% chance of using Bull Rush. Cannot use Bull Rush three times in a row. At Ascension 18, Gremlin Nob uses Skull Bash on the 2nd turn and uses Bull Rush twice afterwards, then repeats this pattern for the rest of the fight.

enemies.name: Lagavulin
enemies.pattern: [When found in an Elite encounter:] Starts off Sleeping. If it takes any damage, it will be stunned for one turn and then proceed to attack. If three turns pass without any damage taken, it will awake and immediately begin attacking. Once awoken, its Metallicize will be removed. When attacking it will repeat this pattern: * Attack * Attack * Siphon Soul [When found in the Dead Adventurer fight:] Spawns already awake and will repeat this pattern: * Siphon Soul * Attack * Attack

enemies.name: Sentry

moves.name: Bolt
moves.effect: Adds 2 (A18: 3) Dazed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Uses Bolt followed by Beam, repeating for the rest of the combat. In the Elite encounter, the middle Sentry instead uses Beam followed by Bolt.
encounters: Act 2 hard: Sentry and Spheric Guardian

enemies.name: Book of Stabbing

moves.name: Multi Stab
moves.effect: Deals 6×N (A3: 7×N) damage. N = Number of times Multi Stab was used this combat, plus 2. (A18: On, N = Current turn, plus 1.)

enemies.pattern: 15% chance to use Big Stab and an 85% chance to use Multi Stab. Cannot use Multi Stab 3 times in a row and cannot use Big Stab twice in a row.
passives: Painful Stabs — Whenever you receive attack damage from this enemy, add X Wounds into your discard pile.

enemies.name: Gremlin Leader

moves.name: Encourage
moves.effect: All enemies gain 3 (A3: 4; A18: 5) Strength. Other enemies gain 6 (A18: 10) Block.

enemies.pattern: Depending on the amount of enemies in battle, Gremlin Leader will use one of the following actions each turn: [With 0 Gremlins] * Rally! (75% chance) * Stab (25% chance) [With 1 Gremlin] * Rally! (50% chance)* * Stab (50% chance)*:* If last used action was Encourage or * Rally! (62.5% chance)** * Encourage (37.5% chance)**:** If last used action was Stab [With 2 or more Gremlins] * Encourage (66% chance) * Stab (34% chance) Gremlin Leader cannot use any intent twice in a row. No more than 3 small Gremlins can be present at once.

enemies.name: Taskmaster

moves.name: Scouring Whip
moves.effect: Deals 7 damage. Adds 1 Wound (A2: 2; A18: 3 Wounds) into your discard pile. (A18: Gains 1 Strength.)

enemies.pattern: (single move) Uses Scouring Whip every turn.

enemies.name: Giant Head

moves.name: It Is Time
moves.effect: Deals 30 (A3: 40) damage, increased by 5 for each time It Is Time has been used this combat up to a maximum of 60 (A3: 70) damage.

enemies.pattern: For the first 4 (A18: 3) turns, it has a 50/50 chance to use either Count or Glare. Cannot use either move three times in a row. Afterwards, it repeats It Is Time for the rest of combat.
passives: Slow — Whenever you play a card, target receives 10% more damage from Attacks this turn. (Receives (X+10)% more damage)

enemies.name: Nemesis

moves.name: Tri Burn
moves.effect: Adds 3 (A18: 5) Burns into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: On its first turn has a 50/50 chance of using either Tri Burn or Tri Attack. Afterwards it has approximately these chances: * Tri Burn (35% chance) * Tri Attack (35% chance) * Scythe (30% chance) Cannot use Tri Burn or Scythe twice in a row. Cannot use Tri Attack three times in a row.

enemies.name: Reptomancer

moves.name: Spawn Dagger
moves.effect: Summons 1 Dagger (A18: 2 Daggers) (up to a maximum of 4).

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Spawn Dagger. Afterward it has an approximately equal chance of using Snake Strike, Big Bite, and Spawn Dagger. Cannot use Snake Strike or Big Bite twice in a row. Cannot use Spawn Dagger three times in a row. Only 4 Daggers can be in play at any time. If Spawn Dagger was chosen with 4 Daggers in play, it will use Snake Strike instead.

enemies.name: Spire Shield

moves.name: Bash
moves.effect: Deals 12 (A3: 14) damage. If the Player has an Orb Slot, there is 50% chance to apply -1 Focus. Otherwise applies -1 Strength.

moves.name: Smash
moves.effect: Deals 34 (A3: 38) damage. Gains Block equal to damage dealt. (A18: Gains 99 Block.)

enemies.pattern: Every three turns, starting from turn 3, it uses Smash. Otherwise has a 50/50 chance of using: * Bash followed by Fortify * Fortify followed by Bash
encounters: Act 4 elite: Spire Shield and Spire Spear

enemies.name: Spire Spear

moves.name: Burn Strike
moves.effect: Deals 5×2 (A3: 6×2) damage. Adds 2 Burns into your discard pile. (A18: Adds 2 Burns on top of your draw pile.)

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Burn Strike. Every 3 turns, starting from turn 2, it uses Skewer. Otherwise has a 50/50 chance of using: * Burn Strike followed by Piercer * Piercer followed by Burn Strike
encounters: Act 4 elite: Spire Shield and Spire Spear

enemies.name: Hexaghost

moves.name: Divider
moves.effect: Deals (N+1)×6 damage. N = Player's HP at the start of the turn, divided by 12 (rounded down).

moves.name: Sear
moves.effect: Deals 6 damage. Adds 1 (A19: 2) Burns into your discard pile.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.effect: Deals 2×6 (A4: 3×6) damage. Adds 3 Burns+ into your discard pile. Upgrades all Burns. For the rest of combat, any Burn created by Sear will be upgraded.

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Activate followed by Divider. For the rest of combat, repeats the following pattern: # Sear # Tackle # Sear # Inflame # Tackle # Sear # Inferno

enemies.name: Slime Boss

moves.name: Goop Spray
moves.effect: Adds 3 (A19: 5) Slimed into your discard pile.

moves.name: Split
moves.effect: Disappears and spawns 1 Acid Slime (L) and 1 Spike Slime (L) with its current HP.

enemies.pattern: Repeats the following pattern: #Goop Spray #Preparing #Slam Once its HP reaches 50% or lower, its current Intent will be immediately changed to Split.

enemies.name: The Guardian

moves.name: Twin Slam
moves.effect: Deals 8×2 damage. Loses Sharp Hide. Gains 30 (A9: 35; A19: 40) Mode Shift, increased by 10 for each time Mode Shift triggered this combat.

enemies.pattern: Repeats the following pattern: #Charging Up #Fierce Bash #Vent Steam #Whirlwind When Guardian triggers Mode Shift the current Intent is replaced with Defensive Mode. After Defensive Mode, Guardian uses Roll Attack, followed by Twin Slam and Whirlwind. Then the initial pattern restarts.
passives: Mode Shift 30 (A9: 35 A19: 40) — After losing X HP, gains 20 Block and changes current Intent to Defensive Mode.

enemies.name: Bronze Automaton
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Spawn Orbs, then repeats the following pattern: #Flail #Boost #Flail #Boost #HYPER BEAM #Stunned On Ascension 19, Bronze Automaton will always use Boost in place of Stunned.

enemies.name: The Champ

moves.name: Face Slap
moves.effect: Deals 12 (A4: 14) damage. Applies 2 Frail and 2 Vulnerable

moves.name: Defensive Stance
moves.effect: Gains 15 (A9: 18; A19: 20) Block and 5 (A9: 6; A19: 7) Metallicize.

moves.name: Anger
moves.effect: Removes all Debuffs. Gains 6 (A4: 9; A19: 12) Strength.

enemies.pattern: [Phase One] Always uses Taunt every 4 turns. On all other turns: * Defensive Stance 15% chance * Gloat (Defensive Stance A19) 15% chance * Face Slap 25% chance * Heavy Slash 45% chance No move can be used twice in a row. When he attempts to use the same move again, he will instead use the next move in the list above. For example, if he used Gloat, there's a 0% chance of him using Gloat again but a 40% chance of him using Face Slap. If he used Heavy Slash, the chance of Heavy Slash will be transferred to Face Slap instead (0% chance of Heavy Slash, 70% chance of Face Slap) On Ascension 19, when Gloat is replaced with Defensive Stance, if the last move was also Defensive Stance, he will instead use Gloat. [Phase Two] When his HP drops below 50%, he will use Anger on the next turn and enter Phase Two. After using Anger he will use Execute the turn after. He will then repeat this pattern for the rest of combat: * Random Move (Same chances as Phase One) * Random Move (Same chances as Phase One) * Execute

enemies.name: The Collector

moves.name: Buff
moves.effect: All enemies gain 3 (A4: 4; A19: 5) Strength. Gains 15 (A9: 18; A19: 23) Block.

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Spawn and always uses Mega Debuff on turn 4. Can only have two Torch Heads summoned at a time. If there are 0-1 Torch Heads alive: * Spawn 25% chance * Fireball 45% chance * Buff 30% chance If both Torch Heads are alive: * Fireball 70% chance * Buff 30% chance She cannot use Buff twice in a row and cannot use Fireball 3 times in a row.

enemies.name: Awakened One

moves.name: Rebirth
moves.effect: Heals to full HP. Removes all Debuffs. Loses Curiosity.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.effect: Deals 18 damage. Adds a Void into your draw pile.

enemies.pattern: [Phase One] Always starts with Slash. Every turn after: * Soul Strike 25% chance * Slash 75% chance Slash cannot be used three times in a row. Soul Strike cannot be used twice in a row. [Phase Two] Once its HP reaches 0, it loses Curiosity and its intent changes to Rebirth. Any Strength gained from Curiosity is kept. Always starts Phase Two with Dark Echo. Afterward, it has a 50/50 chance to use Tackle or Sludge. It cannot use either of these moves three times in a row. The remaining Cultists will flee when the Awakened One is defeated in Phase Two.
passives: Regenerate 10 (A19: 15) — At the end of its turn, heals X HP.
Curiosity 1 (A19: 2) — Whenever you play a Power card, gains X Strength.

enemies.name: Deca

moves.name: Beam
moves.effect: Deals 10×2 (A4: 12×2) damage. Adds 2 Dazed into your discard pile.

moves.name: Square of Protection
moves.effect: All enemies gain 16 Block(A19: and 3 Plated Armor).

enemies.pattern: Alternates between Beam and Square of Protection.

enemies.name: Donu
enemies.pattern: Alternates between Circle of Power and Beam.

enemies.name: Time Eater

moves.name: Head Slam
moves.effect: Deals 26 (A4: 32) damage. Applies 1 Draw Reduction. (A19: Adds 2 Slimed into your discard pile.)

moves.name: Ripple
moves.effect: Gains 20 Block. Applies 1 Vulnerable, 1 Weak. (A19: and 1 Frail.)

moves.name: Haste
moves.effect: Removes all Debuffs. Heals to 50% HP. (A19: Gains 32 Block.)

enemies.pattern: Time Eater will always use Haste when it is reduced to below half HP. Haste can only be used once per combat. Time Eater will use one of the following three attacks each turn: * Reverberate (45% chance) * Head Slam (35% chance) * Ripple (20% chance) Time Eater will not use Reverberate three times in a row, or Head Slam/Ripple twice in a row.
passives: Time Warp — Whenever you play a certain number of cards, ends your turn and gains X Strength.

enemies.name: Corrupt Heart

moves.name: Debilitate
moves.effect: Applies 2 Vulnerable, 2 Weak and 2 Frail. Adds 1 Burn, 1 Dazed, 1 Slimed, 1 Void and 1 Wound into your draw pile.

moves.name: Buff
moves.effect: Loses all negative Strength, then gains 2 Strength. Gains an additional Buff: * 1st buff: 2 Artifact * 2nd buff: 1 Beat of Death * 3rd buff: Painful Stabs * 4th buff: 10 Strength * 5th buff: 50 Strength

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Debilitate. Uses Buff every 3 turns starting from turn 4. On all other turns it has a 50/50 chance to use either Blood Shots followed by Echo or Echo followed by Blood Shots
passives: Beat of Death 1 (A19: 2) — Whenever you play a card, take X damage.
Invincible 300 (A19: 200) — Can only lose X more HP this turn.

enemies.name: Bronze Orb

moves.name: Stasis
moves.effect: Steals a random card of the highest rarity from your draw pile (or discard pile, if the draw pile is empty). On death, returns the card to your hand.

enemies.pattern: Each Bronze Orb can only use Stasis once per combat. Stasis has a 75% chance to be used each turn until it has been picked. After using Stasis Bronze Orb has a 70% chance to use Support Beam and a 30% chance to use Beam each turn. Bronze Orb cannot use the same attack thrice in a row. [Stasis] Stasis will always prioritize the highest rarity Card in your draw pile. If your draw pile is empty, Stasis will pick from your discard pile instead. Cards in Stasis will not be affected by certain variables; for example, Masterful Stab's Energy cost will not increase even if the player takes damage.
